subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - token volumes & peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@shoploom.com>, procurement@shoploom.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification - post-call recap

Hi Samir + team,

Thanks again for the call earlier - quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get a clean pricing sketch over to procurement.

Recap (what I heard):
- Primary use: AI-assisted product copy + on-site chat for shoppers.
- Expected initial traffic: ~300k monthly active users, with the plan to grow to ~1.2M over 12 months.
- Average tokens per request: ~400 tokens (prompt + response).
- Expected monthly token volume (initial / 3-6 mo): ~120M tokens/month.
- Growth target (Q4): up to ~500M tokens/month if engagement ramps as forecasted.
- Target unit economics: roughly $/1M tokens in the range you mentioned on the call (see question below).
- Procurement asked about SOW + pricing sheet for review.

Open questions for pricing:
1) Can you confirm the budget range you have in mind (target $/1M tokens)? Even a ballpark helps us recommend model/quantization options.
2) Peak TPS (requests/sec) during promotional spikes - what peak concurrency should we plan for? You mentioned Black Friday-ish loads; a peak number will help sizing.
3) Any strict latency SLOs for the chat experience (p95 target)?

Next steps:
- If you can reply with budget range and peak TPS, we'll produce a hosted-API pricing sketch + one-page SOW for procurement.
- We can also propose a Dedicated (reserved capacity) comparison if you expect to consistently exceed ~300M tokens/mo - typically worth evaluating for unit-cost savings.

Thanks - I'm looping Marissa on the pricing details; Alex is here for any technical follow-ups.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

P.S. attaching a short pricing checklist and next-steps in the follow-up once you confirm the numbers.

From: Samir Kapoor <samir@shoploom.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@shoploom.com, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - quick answers

Thanks Ben - quick answers below to help you draft the SOW/pricing.

Answers:
- Budget range: for hosted API we were targeting $50-$75 per 1M tokens initially. If we can get predictable unit economics in that band, procurement will feel comfortable.
- Expected monthly token volume (initial): ~150M tokens/month (this is what we expect for the first 6 months based on current conversion).
- Growth plan: we have an aggressive UA plan that could push us to ~400-500M tokens/month by Q4 if adoption goes well.
- Average tokens/request: ~400 as you noted.
- Peak traffic: during promotions we expect burst peaks of ~75-100 requests/sec (we're calling TPS here as requests/sec). Please assume 100 req/s peak for sizing.
- Latency: for chat we want p95 <= 800ms for the model response; p99 under 2s would be ideal.

Procurement note: they asked for a draft SOW and an itemized pricing sheet showing hosted API unit costs and an example monthly bill for 150M tokens.

Happy to hop on a quick pricing call if that helps.

Samir
Samir Kapoor
Head of Product, ShopLoom
samir@shoploom.com | +1 617-555-9987

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@shoploom.com>, procurement@shoploom.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification - SOW & pricing sheet attached

Samir - perfect, thanks for the details. See attached draft SOW and a pricing_sheet.xlsx that shows two options (hosted API standard and a Dedicated reserved-capacity comparison). Highlights below so procurement can scan quickly:

Hosted API (recommended for initial / variable traffic)
- Recommended plan: hosted API with autoscaling + prefix caching.
- Unit price (example): $65 per 1M tokens (this is within your $50-$75 target band; final price depends on commitment and model tier).
- Example cost (150M tokens/mo): 150 * $65 = $9,750/month. (We include a worked example in the sheet.)
- Peak sizing: we recommend planning for 100 req/s peak (you mentioned). At ~400 tokens/req that's ~40k tokens/sec at peak. Our hosted clusters handle that with autoscaling; we include expected latencies in the SOW.

Dedicated (reserved capacity) - if you consistently hit >300M tokens/mo
- Lower unit cost with a monthly commitment; example pricing in the attached sheet shows $45 per 1M tokens with a 12-month reserved commit (numbers are illustrative).
- SLA-backed latency and optional private VPC.

Next steps
1) I've attached SOW_draft.pdf and pricing_sheet.xlsx. Please circulate to procurement; we can redline the SOW as needed.
2) If procurement is happy with the $65/1M example, we can provide a formal quote and a DocuSign link.
3) Marissa or Alex can run a quick technical sizing call to validate peak TPS and p95 latency with your infra team - want to schedule that for next week?

Let me know a good time and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOW_draft.pdf, pricing_sheet.xlsx
